exposure: Adherence to ACOG guidelines on CPD diagnosis
Adherence to RTCOG guidelines on CPD diagnosis
outcome: Degree of adherence to guidelines on the diagnosis of CPD
cohort: 464 pregnant women who underwent cesarean delivery due to CPD between 2010 and 2012 at Maharaj Nakorn Chiang Mai Hospital
finding: The adherence to guidelines on the diagnosis of CPD was 80.4%, with almost one-third of the cases that had no adherence being falsely diagnosed with fetal macrosomia.
birth_weight: Birth weight was recorded, with a focus on those less than 4000 grams
